countercosts: mixedSIMD groups can retain fallback work
cost_hypothesis.material_difference_from_49bfb434: Global27-bit proposal+onewideproduct+one residualdigit rather than one integer reciprocal and four high products/four per-chunk corrections.
cost_hypothesis.material_difference_from_fp64_estimate: Single32-bit bitcast/extraction,bit-built normal operands and no FP64 conversions/arithmetic/capability; adds one correction UInt32 division compared with exact-guess FP64 success path.
cost_hypothesis.ordinary_lowering_speed_benefit_adoption: UNPROVED; reject equivalent/worse lowering before numeric controls.
cost_hypothesis.successful_path: One nativeF32 proposal division,one exactUInt2 product,inlineborrow+range guard,oneuint32 correctiondivision+lowproduct+sticky.

hoare_argument.R: Inline uint32 low subtract plus unsigned high subtract/borrow computes (N-P) mod2^64. Existing PB32WideSubtract(a>=b) is not called.
hoare_argument.acceptance: residualHi==0 && residualLo<(d<<5). Since P,N<2^51, if P>N the modulo difference is >2^64-2^51 and cannot have highword0; accepted R therefore is exact nonnegative N-P<32d.
hoare_argument.accepted_proposal_window: q-h in[-16,15] exactly; correctness does not imply this occurs frequently.
hoare_argument.correction: t=floor(R/d)<32; t*d<2^29; r=R-t*d in[0,d); q=g+t=floor(N/d) in[2^26,2^27). One uint32 correction division and low product; no second wide product or P<=N comparator.
hoare_argument.rejection: No proposal expression modifies original remainder,bb.significand,exponent orsign. Entire original radix8/8/8/2 fallback, sticky andRound remain byte-exact.
hoare_argument.rounding: q|bool(r) is identical to original26fractional-bit quotient and sticky; common original PB32Round handles sign,underflow ties,subnormal transition,overflow and signedzero.

postcondition: Return is bit-equal original PB32Divide for every accepted exact-check path; all rejected proposal paths execute original fallback. This is a source/math argument, not an executed/exhaustive proof.

precondition.finite_guard_precedence: Unchanged original NaN/Inf/zero guards before Unpack; normalized finite nonzero only.
precondition.normalized_significands: 2^23<=d<2^24; d<=m<2d; m is original aa.significand or its exact one-bit double; exponent/sign remain unchanged.
precondition.numerator: N=m*2^26; N<2^51; UInt2 words m<<26 and m>>6.

proposal.exact_operand_identity: Native operands are normal binary32: x=aa.significand*2^(3+k), k=(aa.significand<d); y=d*2^-23; x/y=N/d. No uint-to-float conversion.
proposal.integer_bounds: 2^26<=h<=2^27-8; h multiple8; g=h-16 is nonnegative,<2^27; subtract cannot underflow.
proposal.nonfinite_negative_subnormal_or_outside_: Rejected by integer bit guard before extraction.
